description: Agent-based network simulation of mask-wearing diffusion driven by peer influence, household norms, mobility and enforcement at locations, government policy, information campaigns and media effects, and supply constraints.

modules.name: SocialNetworkBuilder
modules.description: Constructs social contact network, assigns individuals to households and workplaces, and creates public venues.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if t == 0:
  set RNG seed
  create households using Poisson(lambda=household_size_lambda), assign persons sequentially
  build social network:
    if network_type == 'small_world':
      G_person = watts_strogatz(n=population_size, k=avg_degree, p=social_network_rewiring_p)
    elif network_type == 'erdos_renyi':
      G_person = erdos_renyi(n, p=avg_degree/(n-1))
    elif network_type == 'scale_free':
      G_person = barabasi_albert(n, m=max(1, avg_degree//2))
  create workplaces_count = ceil(population_size * workplaces_per_1000 / 1000)
  assign employed persons to workplaces uniformly
  create public_venues_count = ceil(population_size * public_venues_per_1000 / 1000)
  sample capacity for each location from Lognormal centered at location_capacity_mean
  set initial policy_requires_mask on a random sample of venues with probability 0.0 (will be set by GovernmentPolicy)
notes: Runs only at t=0; outputs are static structures accessible by other modules.
Household norms initialized as average of members' initial mask_use_state.

modules.name: GovernmentPolicy
modules.description: Activates or deactivates mask mandates, sets campaign intensity, allocates enforcement across locations, and sets venue policy coverage.

update_rule.pseudocode:
mandate_active = (t >= mandate_start_day) and (t <= mandate_end_day)
if mandate_active:
  campaign_intensity = information_campaign_strength
  target_coverage = venue_policy_coverage
else:
  campaign_intensity = 0.5 * information_campaign_strength
  target_coverage = 0.1 * venue_policy_coverage
assign mask policies to a fraction target_coverage of workplaces and public venues (prioritize high capacity)
allocate enforcement budget:
  total_locations = count(policy_requires_mask==True)
  per_location_budget = (enforcement_budget / max(1, total_locations)) * enforcement_level
  set enforcement_allocations[loc] = per_location_budget for each covered location
notes: This module sets policy flags and coverage. Other modules should read mandate_active and campaign_intensity.
Reactive policy adjustments can be added: if adoption below threshold, increase enforcement_level (optional extension).

modules.name: InformationCampaign
modules.description: Broadcasts risk and mask-related information combining government campaign and media, updating persons' perceptions.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person i:
  trust = Person[i].trust_in_authorities
  media_effect = media_message_strength * (1 + media_bias) - misinformation_strength
  if risk_signal_type == 'constant': risk_signal = risk_level
  elif risk_signal_type == 'wave': risk_signal = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(2*pi*t/risk_wave_period) * risk_level
  else: risk_signal = risk_level
  delta_risk = 0.5 * policy_state.campaign_intensity * trust + 0.5 * media_effect
  Person[i].risk_perception = clip((Person[i].risk_perception * 0.8) + 0.2 * (risk_signal + delta_risk), 0, 1)
  Person[i].perceived_mask_benefit = clip(perceived_mask_benefit_base + mask_effectiveness_perceived * (trust * policy_state.campaign_intensity + media_effect)/2, 0, 1)
  Person[i].perceived_mask_cost = clip(perceived_cost_base + 0.2 * (1 - trust) + 0.3 * (1 - policy_state.campaign_intensity) + 0.1 * media_bias_negative, 0, 1)
where media_bias_negative = max(0, -media_bias)
notes: Perceptions are smoothed (0.8 carry-over) to avoid abrupt changes.
mask_effectiveness_perceived and perceived_cost_base are read from Decision module parameters via global registry.

modules.name: ProcurementAndSupply
modules.description: Manages supplier inventory, pricing, distribution, and agents' mask acquisition behavior.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if t % supplier_resupply_period == 0:
  supplier.inventory += population_size * mask_supply_per_capita * supplier_distribution_rate
# price adjustment
if demand_last_day > supply_last_day:
  supplier.price = supplier.price * (1 + supplier_price_adjustment_rate)
else:
  supplier.price = max(0.1, supplier.price * (1 - 0.5 * supplier_price_adjustment_rate))
# agent procurement
procured_today = 0
stockout_flag = 0
for person i:
  desired = 1 if Person[i].mask_inventory == 0 and (policy_state.mandate_active or Person[i].mask_use_state) else 0
  affordability = 1 if supplier.price <= mask_cost * (1 + 1/price_elasticity) else 0
  access = Bernoulli(procurement_access_fraction)
  if desired and affordability and access and supplier.inventory > 0:
    qty = 1
    Person[i].mask_inventory += qty
    supplier.inventory -= qty
    procured_today += qty
if supplier.inventory <= 0 and any desired unmet:
  stockout_flag = 1
output daily.procured_masks = procured_today and observable.mask_stockouts_daily = stockout_flag
notes: Demand heuristic: one mask needed when inventory is zero and agent intends or must wear.
Price dynamics are simple elasticity-based; can be replaced by more detailed demand models.

modules.name: MobilityAndEnforcement
modules.description: Simulates daily visits to locations and enforces mask policy at entry, generating enforcement actions and compliance outcomes.

notes: Entry compliance pressure can induce temporary wearing (consumes a mask).
Enforcement strictness is modulated by per-location allocations and a global mean.

modules.name: DecisionAndHabitFormation
modules.description: Updates individual mask-wearing decisions via logistic choice based on peer influence, risk, policy, habit, and costs/benefits.

update_rule.pseudocode:
new_adopters = 0
for each person i:
  peer_frac = mean(mask_use_state[j] for j in neighbors(i)) if degree>0 else 0
  hh_frac = Household[household_id(i)].household_norm_mask_use
  observed_context = observations.by_person_context[i]
  risk_term = risk_sensitivity * Person[i].risk_perception
  benefit_term = perceived_mask_benefit_base * Person[i].perceived_mask_benefit
  cost_term = perceived_cost_base + Person[i].perceived_mask_cost + supplier.price/10
  habit_term = Person[i].habit_strength
  policy_term = 0.5 if policy_state.mandate_active else 0
  expected_penalty_term = policy_term * Person[i].compliance_propensity
  linear_util = peer_influence_weight * (Person[i].susceptibility_to_peer_influence * peer_frac) + household_influence_weight * hh_frac + observation_weight * observed_context + risk_term + benefit_term - cost_term + habit_term + expected_penalty_term
  p_wear = 1 / (1 + exp(-linear_util))
  prev = Person[i].mask_use_state
  wear = Bernoulli(p_wear)
  Person[i].mask_use_state = wear
  if wear and not prev: new_adopters += 1; Person[i].last_wore_day = t
  # habit update
  if wear: Person[i].habit_strength = clip(Person[i].habit_strength + habit_formation_rate, 0, 1)
  else: Person[i].habit_strength = clip(Person[i].habit_strength * (1 - compliance_decay_rate), 0, 1)
update Household norms as mean of members' mask_use_state
output observable.daily_new_adopters = new_adopters
notes: Decision uses a logistic (sigmoid) mapping of a linear utility.
Cost term includes a small component of current price to reflect affordability.

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates daily observables and computes derived metrics.

update_rule.pseudocode:
adoption_rate = mean(Person.mask_use_state)
record observable.adoption_rate_daily = adoption_rate
record observable.enforcement_actions_daily = daily.enforcement_actions
record observable.compliance_rate_mandate_daily from MobilityAndEnforcement
compute adoption_by_context using last observed in households/workplace/public via observations.by_person_context and household norms
compute variance by age groups (e.g., <30, 30-49, 50+) using group means
update time_to_50 if first time adoption_rate >= 0.5
if t > mandate_end_day and t == mandate_end_day + 14:
  compute post_mandate_persistence = fraction of individuals wearing at t among those who wore on day mandate_end_day
output observables and metrics
notes: This module centralizes all observable outputs.
Age variance uses fixed bins; can be configured if needed.
